about: Brite Wholesale Electric Supply, Inc. was founded in 1984 in Shepherdsville, Kentucky, and has served Hardin County and the surrounding communities for four decades. The company operates six locations throughout Kentucky, distributing electrical supplies and materials for residential, commercial, and industrial projects and maintenance. Its services include free local delivery across many communities in its service area. Brite Wholesale serves electrical contractors, maintenance departments, and project managers across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors throughout Kentucky. As an Owner-Member of AD, a national network of independent electrical distributors, the company leverages collective purchasing power and shared expertise to compete effectively while maintaining a focus on customer service.
